title: Busting through a closet then accessing the roof wooden cement realm feeling
content: I tend to hide inside closets a lot because normally I’m fighting a war and have people chasing after me so I somehow end up inside the roof and have to work through so much of what feels like an attic. Once I bust out I land into a cement like room and then it feels like an auto shop or warehouses steel doors. If I manage to get into a warehouse it then leads to what feels like a trap house where they are looking for candidates to sell for drugs or other messed up stuff. There’s multiple rooms I can go into them and the rooms are always unkempt, lights are either on or off and I can never change the lighting aspect.
